verdicts.quote: A permitted user can identify and open Grok through signed-in Salesforce Lightning navigation without a separate website, a copied URL, or a separate xAI login.
It does not include Salesforce record fields, IDs, page context, user identity, permission data or Salesforce session material drawn from the org.
The conversation content consists of the submitted text and the bounded prior user and assistant text. It does not include Salesforce record fields
Bot administration requires a separate administrative grant... Bot-use access alone confers none of these operations.
After a view ends, there is no bot-provided way for a user or administrator to retrieve its draft, prompts, answers or pending outcomes.
A synchronous record-trigger transaction cannot obtain a Grok answer by making an Apex callout inline.
verdicts.missing: The constraints (trigger, uncommitted DML in C-77) are stated, but the spec never chooses an asynchronous execution design (Queueable, future, batch, continuation); C-133 even contemplates synchronous Apex.

verdicts.quote: inspect the bot page, chat browser traffic, user feedback, operator diagnostics, app logs and deployment artifacts. None receives the configured key from the bot.
verdicts.missing: Where the secret is stored (Named/External Credential or protected setting) is left conditional and undecided.

verdicts.quote: would exceed 100 callouts... Salesforce defaults to 10 seconds... caps cumulative callout waiting per transaction at 120 seconds... 6 MB in synchronous Apex... 10,000 ms for synchronous Apex
omit its outbound authorization. The smoke attempt fails before reaching xAI. Salesforce requires an approved remote site or an applicable Named Credential for the destination.
After an admitted send, the user sees that a reply is pending until the turn succeeds, fails, or the conversation view is lost.
verdicts.missing: The mechanism by which the view learns the answer arrived (inline return, polling, platform event, continuation) is not decided.

verdicts.quote: Complete a turn, then deliver the same answer again. The transcript has one entry for that turn, containing its submitted prompt and one answer.
the org already has 20 concurrent external callouts, a new bot callout can fail without an answer.
verdicts.missing: Concurrent-callout limits are named, but no queue/async-job depth limit or behaviour for a request that cannot be enqueued is stated.

verdicts.quote: For a capacity or account refusal the user can retry later or seek administrator help. For a timeout, transport, Salesforce runtime or other provider failure the user can explicitly resend or seek help.
Observe no second provider inference call unless the user explicitly submits again.
If the provider reports that generation reached an output ceiling before finishing, the turn fails without exposing a fragment as an answer.
each consisting of the submitted user text followed by the answer text
verdicts.missing: No persisted conversation/turn shape; status, timestamps, model identifier and usage counts per turn are undefined (spec chooses no stored records, C-36).

verdicts.quote: A conversation is available only during the lifetime of its open view... The bot has no saved transcripts or cross-device history.
The bot does not automatically include Salesforce data in an inference request.
supplies up to the 5 most recent successful prompt-and-answer pairs in their original order, followed by the new prompt.
sees an empty transcript... Submit an empty string... A nonblank prompt of 1–4,000 Unicode code points, inclusive, passes... response at 12,000 code points is displayed intact.
Attempt an operator smoke prompt in an open view. Its latest outcome identifies one of success, local access refusal, paused...
verdicts.missing: Pause (C-12) and model change (C-29) are covered, but the administrator can see only their own latest smoke outcome, not failed requests from ordinary users.

verdicts.quote: xAI documents a 30-day default audit retention period and a Zero Data Retention option.
verdicts.missing: No Salesforce-side audit record of who asked what and what was answered; C-99 excludes chat content from logs.

verdicts.quote: A Developer Edition org, development sandbox, or scratch org qualifies if designated... Salesforce requires at least 75% aggregate Apex coverage.
verdicts.missing: The deployment mechanism (metadata deployment vs managed package) is left conditional, and how configuration differs per environment is not stated.

verdicts.quote: If no terminal outcome is available within 30 seconds of submission, the open, responsive view exits pending and shows a timeout.
The open view distinguishes the actions a user can take after refusal or failure.
Compare existing navigation entries, metadata, permissions and external connections unrelated to the bot... Their definitions and assignments stay unchanged by bot work.
